name: Gasthaus Zur schönen Aussicht
beschreibung: The Gasthaus Zur schönen Aussicht in Rettenschöss is a traditional inn in Tirol. The location offers a view of the surrounding mountain landscape. The atmosphere at the house is down-to-earth and characterized by regional hospitality. Guests can expect accommodation with simple rooms for overnight stays. The amenities include a restaurant serving dishes from Tirol and a terrace. In the surrounding area, guests can go hiking in nature. The house is suitable for travelers who appreciate peace and authenticity.
